llms.body:
# Securly - The Student Safety Company

Cloud-based student safety and device management solutions that work anywhere, at school and at home. Setup in minutes.

## Overview of Securly Solutions

- [Securly Platform](https://www.securly.com/solutions/all-solutions): Discover what you can do with Securly by your side, offering a comprehensive suite of tools for student safety and engagement.
- [safetyOS](https://www.securly.com/safetyOS): The platform architecture connecting safety, wellness, engagement, and technology into one coordinated system.

### Student Safety and Wellness

- [Student Safety](https://www.securly.com/solutions/student-safety): Focused on ensuring the safety of students in various environments.
- [Student Wellness](https://www.securly.com/solutions/student-wellness): Tools and resources aimed at promoting the overall wellness of students.
- [Aware](https://www.securly.com/aware): Online student wellness monitoring to track and support student mental health.
- [On-Call](https://www.securly.com/on-call): Securly-managed alert analysis for Aware, providing timely responses to student needs.
- [Campus Safety](https://www.securly.com/campus-safety): Tools for managing safety across the physical school campus.

### Content Filtering and AI Visibility

- [Filter](https://www.securly.com/filter): Cloud web filtering for schools to ensure safe browsing for students.
- [AI Transparency](https://www.securly.com/AItransparency): Visibility into how students are using AI tools, with alerts for concerning activity.
- [AI Usage Insights](https://www.securly.com/aiusageinsights): Dashboards showing district-wide student AI usage patterns.

### Classroom and Device Management

- [Classroom](https://www.securly.com/classroom): Classroom management solutions designed for teachers to enhance learning environments.
- [Classroom Management](https://www.securly.com/classroom-management): Guidance and tools for keeping students focused during instructional time.
- [MDM](https://www.securly.com/mdm): Apple device management solutions for effective oversight of student devices.
- [Reveal](https://www.securly.com/reveal): Edtech usage and budget analysis for district technology decisions.

### Scheduling and Student Movement

- [Pass](https://www.securly.com/pass): Digital hall pass system to manage student movement within schools.
- [Flex](https://www.securly.com/flex): Flex period scheduling for K-12 schools, with automated student assignment.

### Engagement and Support

- [Student Engagement](https://www.securly.com/solutions/student-engagement): Strategies and tools to foster active participation among students.
- [Home](https://www.securly.com/home-select): Family engagement app for Filter, enhancing communication between schools and families.

## Resources and Community

- [Case studies](https://www.securly.com/case-studies): See how Securly has helped schools just like yours improve student safety and engagement.
- [Support team](https://www.securly.com/support): Find out what makes our support team best in class, ready to assist with any inquiries.
- [Helpful reads](https://www.securly.com/helpful-reads): Explore resources to support your school, students, and technology.
- [Blog](https://blog.securly.com/): Stay up to date on trends and news in K-12 student safety and wellness.
- [Product briefs](https://www.securly.com/product-briefs): View detailed information sheets on Securly's products to understand their features and benefits.

## Additional Information

- [Partners](https://www.securly.com/partners): Information about Securly's partnerships and collaborations.
- [Privacy Policies](https://www.securly.com/privacy): Review Securly's privacy policies to understand data handling practices.
- [GDPR](https://www.securly.com/gdpr): Information on compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation.
- [COPPA](https://www.securly.com/childrens-online-privacy): Details on compliance with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act.
- [Trust and Safety](https://www.securly.com/trust-and-safety): Certifications, data handling commitments, and responsible AI practices.
- [Terms of service](https://www.securly.com/terms-and-conditions): Review the terms governing the use of Securly's services.

## Contact and Support

- [Contact](https://www.securly.com/contact-us): Get in touch with Securly for inquiries or support.
- [1 (855) 732-8759](tel:1-855-7328759): Contact number for support in the U.S.
- [+44 808 164 9773](tel:+448081649773): Contact number for support in the UK.
- [+44 141 343 8322](tel:+441413438322): Additional contact number for UK support.
- [sales@securly.com](mailto:sales@securly.com): Email for sales inquiries.
- [support@securly.com](mailto:support@securly.com): Email for support-related questions.
- [homesupport@securly.com](mailto:homesupport@securly.com): Email for home user support.

## Case Studies

- [Atlanta Public Schools + Securly Classroom](https://www.securly.com/case-studies/atlanta-public-schools): Creating engaging and safe learning environments across a large urban district.
- [Virginia Beach City Public Schools + Securly](https://www.securly.com/case-studies/virginia-beach): How a large district approaches student safety at scale.
- [Frederick County Public Schools + Securly Filter](https://www.securly.com/case-studies/frederick-county-public-schools): Content filtering deployed across a full district device fleet.
- [Pickens County + Securly Aware](https://www.securly.com/case-studies/pickens-county): Using wellness monitoring to identify students who need support.
- [Sheboygan Falls + Securly Filter & Classroom](https://www.securly.com/case-studies/sheboygan-falls): Pairing filtering with classroom management to protect instructional time.
- [Perins MAT + Securly Filter](https://www.securly.com/case-studies/perins-mat-uk): Filtering deployed across a UK multi-academy trust.

Request a demo

Keep every student
safe, secure, and ready to learn

Securly safetyOS brings together every layer of K-12 student safety into one intelligent platform.

Get a demoSee how safetyOS works

The gold standard for K-12 digital safety and critical IT infrastructure

Your SIS runs attendance and grades. Your LMS runs teaching and learning. Securly safetyOS runs student safety: blocking content students shouldn't see, flagging signs of distress so your team can step in early, and keeping classrooms focused and hallways calm. District and school leaders get one view of all of it, with insights no single tool could give them.

18.6B+

sites filtered per month

20M+

students supported

2,600+

lives saved

All the safety tools you need to power your school district

Each Securly product is purpose-built for K-12 and to be the best at its job. Together, they give your team fewer things to manage and more ways to keep students safe.

Filter

Securly Filter

The first cloud-native content filter built specifically for K-12.

  • Protect students on any device, anywhere
  • AI-powered site categorization and proxy detection
  • Give parents customizable control with the Securly Home App
  • Safe GenAI
  • AI-powered Proxy Detection
  • EdTech Analytics
  • Patented iPad Filtering
  • Filtering SmartDNS
Learn more

AI Transparency

Get the visibility and control needed to embrace AI safely.

  • Put guardrails on AI use just like you filter the web
  • See every prompt, and a birds-eye view dashboard of AI usage
  • Works across multiple third-party AI tools
  • Policy-Driven Guardrails
  • Transparency Dashboard
  • Prompt-Level Visibility
  • Safety Alerts
  • Filter and Monitor Third-party AI Tools
Learn more

Securly Aware

AI driven safety monitoring that surfaces concerning behavior before it becomes a crisis.

  • Analyze online activity for signs of cyberbullying, self-harm, and violence
  • The most comprehensive online safety monitoring
  • Easily manage student cases, even with limited resources
  • Human-powered Alerts
  • Case Management
  • Wellness Levels
  • Proactive Safety
  • Real-world observation
Learn More

Securly Classroom

Give teachers real-time visibility and powerful tools to maximize instructional time.

  • See exactly what students are working on without leaving the front of the room
  • Share screens, lock devices, push resources, and more
  • Block native apps and see full desktops on Windows and Mac devices
  • Screen Monitoring
  • Transparency Dashboard
  • Defeat Distractions
  • Full Windows and Mac Support
  • Integrate with Filter and Pass
Learn More

Securly Pass

The original digital hall pass. Replace paper passes with a system that keeps hallways calm and classrooms focused.

  • Reduce class disruption and reclaim instructional time
  • Ensure accountability, prevent meetups, and improve campus safety
  • Now includes tardy management, visitor management, and PBIS at no extra cost
  • Digital Hall Pass
  • PBIS
  • Tardy Management
  • Visitor Management
  • District and School Insights
Learn more

Securly Home

The family app more than 1.5 million parents use to stay involved with their child’s learning at home.

  • Allow parents to view their child’s activity on their school-owned device
  • Give parents control over devices when they go home
  • Track parent adoption across your district from one dashboard
  • Pause internet
  • Offline schedules
  • Weekly email reports
  • Opt-in safety alerts
  • Multi-language support
Learn more

Securly Reveal

Measure how school devices are actually used, and turn screen time into screen value you can prove.

  • View screen time by district, school, grade, and student
  • Count active screens only, during the hours your district chooses
  • Track approval status for every licensed app, then automatically publish your approved list for teachers and parents to see
  • Screen time dashboard
  • App and website usage
  • Edtech ROI
  • Subscription Management
  • State Reporting
Learn more

Our data and privacy and security certifications

Securly is FERPA, COPPA, and GDPR compliant and SOC 2 Type 2 certified. We never sell, rent, or trade student data, and we never use it for advertising. Privacy isn't an afterthought. It's built into everything we do.

View our Trust and Safety page

What schools and districts say about Securly

"There’s no problem that I can think of that sticks out right now where Securly hasn’t been able to solve it."
Kevin Eshelman,
Director of Technology,
Everett Area School District (PA)
"Securly’s site categorization has been so effective that we have not received a single request to unblock a site this school year. This is unprecedented."
Cory Ulrich,
System And Database Administrator,
Elgin School District U-46 (IL)
"Securly has helped us save 4 student lives just this year - and you can’t put a monetary value on that."
Michael Jaber,
Director of Technology Education,
Sheboygan Area School District (WI)
View our case studies

See how safetyOS can help your district

Securly gives your school or district one platform for filtering, monitoring and classroom management. See why 27,000+ schools nationwide trust Securly.
